problems.insecureTitle: The microphone needs a secure connection
problems.insecure: Browsers only lend the microphone over HTTPS, and {appName} runs over http here. Until HTTPS arrives: open {flag} in Chrome, enter {origin}, choose “Enabled” and restart Chrome. Safari and Firefox: only with HTTPS.
problems.flagCopied: Address copied – paste it into Chrome's address bar.
problems.localOnlyDownTitle: Local transcription is unavailable right now
problems.localOnlyDown: Transcription is set to “Local only”: your voice does not leave this machine, so the browser does not step in. Try again shortly or check Administrator → Local AI.
problems.unsupported: Turn on “Transcription (dictation)” under Administrator → Local AI – Whisper on this machine then writes along, in any browser.
problems.blocked: The browser did not allow the microphone. Allow it in the site settings (the icon at the left of the address bar).
problems.failed: The microphone could not be started.
problems.recognitionFailed: The browser's speech recognition does not answer (Chrome sends the recording to Google for it). With Administrator → Local AI → “Transcription”, Whisper on this machine writes along.
problems.voiceFailed: The local voice failed. The answer is in the chat; where allowed, the browser reads on.
problems.nothingHeard: Nothing understood – was the microphone on?
problems.limit: Stopped after {seconds} seconds – the longest a dictation can be.
problems.echo: On loudspeakers, interrupt me with “Interrupt” from now on. With headphones or the local voice, speaking works too.

voice.misheard: Didn't catch that – please say it again.
voice.timings: Last answer after {total} s: pause {pause} s · transcription {transcribe} s · answer {answer} s · voice {voice} s
voice.replyLine: Fast voice reply ({model}) – not the agent

jev.saved: Jev first stage for this chat: {mode}
jev.scope: Applies to the optional chat pre-decision. Team, class and privacy permissions still apply. On and Inherit follow the team setting.
jev.needsChat: Start or open a chat first.
jev.usage: Use /jev on, /jev off or /jev inherit. /jev shows the saved value.

runtimePicker.title: Change runtime
runtimePicker.scope: Applies to this agent (all chats). Confirming starts a new chat.
runtimePicker.commandScriptHint: Path relative to the project folder. The script gets the task as JSON and runs in the project's isolated area; its output is the result.
runtimePicker.webhookHint: {appName} calls the address signed per Standard Webhooks. Give the agent the key (whsec_…) as an environment variable under Access.
